xwikidoc.content: sopManager.import.title=Import documents sopManager.import.description=Import the documents of a folder of the server as SOP documents: Word documents (docx), Word 97-2003 documents (doc, converted by the office server) and PDF documents with their structure (exported by Word). The files of the same name in different formats are versions of the same document: the analysis tells where each version comes from, which one is the original, and recommends the version keeping the most of the content and of its formatting. The persons named in the documents (who last modified them, the last modification of all their versions counting, who approved and revised them) are looked up among the users of the wiki, to be set as owner, approver and reviewer: check the user proposed for each role, compared with the names written in the document, and change it if needed. Preview the versions, select the ones to import, then import them. Each document is created in the SOP Manager space with the status "Imported", outside of the review process: start its review from the table of the SOP Manager. The code, the title and the release details of the page header and footer are stored in the SOP data and removed from the content. Existing pages are not modified. sopManager.import.notAllowed=You need the edit right on the SOP Manager space to import documents. sopManager.import.folder=Folder sopManager.import.folder.hint=The absolute path of the folder on the server, e.g. /var/lib/xwiki/sop-import.
